title: Self-Dual Lattice Function
body_html:
Self-Dual Lattice Function

Let \(V\) carry a nondegenerate sesquilinear form. For an \(o_D\)-lattice \(L\subseteq V\), its dual is \[ L^\vee=\{v\in V : \langle v,L\rangle_V\subseteq \mathbf p_D\}. \]

For a lattice function \(L\), the dual lattice function is defined by \[ (L^\vee)_s=(L_{(-s)+})^\vee. \] The lattice function is self-dual when \(L=L^\vee\). Under the Bruhat-Tits identification for classical groups, points in the building correspond to self-dual lattice functions.
